function.name: share_doc
function.description: Create a token-protected, shareable viewer link for one of your markdown artifacts. Returns a viewer URL plus HTML and PDF export URLs. Send the URL to the user instead of pasting long documents. The link is multi-use and expires after the configured TTL (default 7 days). The viewer always renders the current file content.

filename.description: Plain basename of a .md artifact in your artifacts directory, e.g. "report.md".

template.description: Visual template. Defaults to the plugin DEFAULT_TEMPLATE (paper).
